candidates.from: Lea County, New Mexico (new compressor station)

evidence.note: FERC docket CP26-534-000, filed 2026-05-28: about 16.2 miles of new interstate pipeline plus a compressor station in Lea County NM and Gaines County TX, 361,600 Dth/d for a new power plant.
15.1 miles of 24-inch in Lea County NM plus 1.1 miles of 16-inch in Gaines County TX, cost $104.9 million, serves SPS Gaines County Generating Station.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row. Length 16.2 mi (about 26 km), just over the 25 km floor. Roster has only Northern Natural Northern Lights expansions (P2578, P3942, P3943, P7772) and the Main Line P2579, none in Lea or Gaines County. Not among the EIA seeds I could see.
